jobs.title: Product Design, Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About Persona

Persona https://withpersona.com/ is the configurable identity platform built for businesses in a digital-first world. Verifying individuals and organizations is harder — but more important — than ever, with AI enabling fraudsters to launch sophisticated accounts at scale and regulations evolving rapidly.

We’ve built Persona to support practically every use case and industry — that’s why we’re able to serve a wide range of leading companies. For example, Reddit relies on Persona for age assurance and verification to comply with online safety regulations, protecting younger users while maintaining a seamless experience. Meanwhile, OpenAI relies on Persona to keep bad actors out, protecting one of the world’s most powerful AI platforms from large-scale abuse in a time when AI is reshaping the way we work and live.

We’re growing rapidly and looking for exceptional people to join us!

About the Role

We're looking for a highly motivated and talented Product Design Intern to join our team for the summer of 2026. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, B2B SaaS environment. You'll work on real projects, contribute to our design system, and collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers.

 

We Are Looking For: 

 - A student currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Product Design, HCI, or a related field, graduating in December 2026/Spring 2027.

 - A strong communicator who can effectively present ideas and rationale.

 - Proficient in design and prototyping tools like Figma.

 - A problem-solver with a passion for creating simple, elegant solutions to complex problems.

 - A portfolio that showcases your design process, including case studies of past projects.

 

Compensation & Benefits

 - Generous Relocation support

 - MacBook Pro laptop and additional equipment you need to be successful in your internship

 - Catered lunch in the office 4x a week (Tue - Fri)

 - Bevsday: Expense a beverage of your choice every Wednesday

 - Intern exclusive events, offsites, & swag

Benefits and Perks

For full-time US-based employees (excluding internship and contractor opportunities), Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, and vision, 3% 401(k) contribution, unlimited PTO, quarterly mental health days, family planning benefits, professional development stipend, wellness benefits, among others. 


For full-time UK employees, Persona offers a wide range of benefits, including private medical insurance, dental insurance, a 6% employer pension contribution, unlimited PTO, a monthly wellness stipend, professional development stipend, co-working stipend, and more.


As part of our interview process, all candidates will be asked to verify their identity with Persona. This step is used solely to confirm that candidates are who they say they are, and will have no impact on hiring decisions.

Join us in building the future of finance.

 Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

 About the team + role 

 We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

 Robinhood Ventures’ vision is to build a new kind of venture capital platform, making the best private companies in the world accessible to retail investors everywhere in service of Robinhood's broader mission to democratize finance for all. Through our publicly traded funds in Robinhood Ventures Fund I and Robinhood Ventures Fund II we’ve already invested in companies like OpenAI, Databricks, Ramp, and more - and we’re just getting started.

 As an Investment Intern in Robinhood Ventures you will be a core part of our lean team. You will research, evaluate, and support investments across the Robinhood Ventures platform, with a focus on late-stage investments.  

 This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.  

 At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

 What you’ll do 

• Research and sourcing - You’ll research markets and sectors that you believe we should be paying attention to, and then identify the key companies in them that Robinhood Ventures needs to meet.   

• Investment evaluation - You’ll be a key part of the deal team for investments we evaluate. You’ll own core diligence workstreams like the financial model, competitive analysis, and help shape investment theses. 

• Platform building - You’ll work with teams across Product, Operations, Marketing, Legal, and more to help build experiences in the Robinhood app to further differentiate Robinhood Ventures for both retail investors and portfolio companies. 

 What you bring 

• Currently enrolled in a full-time MBA program 

• Prior experience in investment banking, private equity, or finance at a high-growth company, with fluency in financial modeling, valuation analysis, and market research; late-stage investing or venture capital experience is a plus

• Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated interest in emerging technologies and the private companies driving them — you proactively form opinions on key trends and companies

• An existing network in the startup ecosystem, or the drive to build one, that can help Robinhood Ventures identify and connect with promising companies

• Proven ability to work independently in lean, high-output environments, with experience collaborating across cross-functional teams

 What we offer

• Market competitive compensation structure

• Quarterly lifestyle wallet for personal wellness, learning and development, and more

• Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not

• Time away including company holidays, paid time off, and sick time

• Lively office environment with catered meals, fully stocked kitchens, and geo-specific commuter benefits

 Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected hourly range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. 

 Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
 $47 — $47 USD

Datadog is seeking curious, driven interns to join our Product Management team and help build products that improve how engineers monitor and understand their systems. As a Product Management Intern, you'll support the product development lifecycle by partnering closely with Engineering, Design, and Product Marketing to bring new ideas and features to life. You'll gain hands-on experience working on products that serve highly technical customers while contributing to meaningful business and user outcomes. Interns are embedded directly within product teams, working on meaningful initiatives alongside full-time Product Managers and contributing to actual product decisions. Our platform processes over 100 trillion events per day across 30,000+ customers in a multi-cloud environment -- giving you direct exposure to large-scale, real-time systems built by engineers, for engineers. It's an environment where you'll develop product thinking, technical communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills by doing the work, not just observing it.

 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 What You’ll Do: 

• Conduct customer discovery conversations and gather feedback to better understand user needs

• Drive product initiatives from concept through launch alongside Engineering, Design, and Product Marketing teams

• Translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and engineering priorities

• Analyze customer feedback, product data, and market insights to help inform product decisions

• Prepare and deliver technical product demonstrations and communication materials

• Develop technical understanding of Datadog’s observability platform and cloud infrastructure products

• Targeting a 2028 full-time graduation or start date

• Prior internship, project, or academic experience in product management, software engineering, or another product-focused technical role

• Exposure to B2B software product development and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly while collaborating with engineers and other technical stakeholders

• Interested in emerging technologies, including AI-powered developer tools and cloud technologies

• Winter: 

• Jan 4, 2027 - April 23, 2027

• May 24, 2027 - August 20, 2027
May 24, 2027 - August 27, 2027
June 7, 2027 - September 3, 2027

jobs.title: Investment Analyst Intern/Freelance - Secondary Market
jobs.description:
Join the Firm Redefining Private Market Access

 Clifton Partners is where institutional discipline meets entrepreneurial edge.

 We operate at both ends of private markets: as a family office deploying our own capital, and as an advisory boutique. That order matters—we build conviction by investing our own money first, then share our best opportunities with the world's leading families, funds and founders.

 We don't operate like an investment bank. We source, structure and distribute access to the companies shaping tomorrow—the entrepreneur's way: faster, sharper, closer to the people who build—and we've already moved billions doing it, for companies like OpenAI, SpaceX, Revolut, Mistral, and Anthropic.

 Our founding partners bring an unmatched combination: one built the secondary market playbook at UBS, the other built and sold tech companies worth $150M+.

 Together, they're creating the platform that connects the world's best private companies with the capital that understands them.

 The Partners You'll Learn From

 Diane-Rose Dupré

 Diane-Rose Dupré didn't just work at UBS—she became their youngest team head ever in France, leading the Venture & Growth Solutions team.

 She personally structured secondary deals for Revolut's and Klarna's expansion rounds, and OpenAI and Anthropic transactions. Her network reads like a who's who of global institutional investors and the largest family offices.

 When institutions need complex secondary solutions, they call Diane.

 Guillaume Moubeche

 Guillaume Moubeche built lemlist from $1,000 to a $150M valuation, then reached $45M ARR while staying 70% owner.

 He sold 20% for $30M to focus on what he does best: spotting and accessing tomorrow's winners.

 His portfolio includes positions in Groq, Ledger, BackMarket, Revolut, Anthropic and more. His content reaches 250,000+ tech founders and investors weekly.

 When founders need liquidity advice from someone who's been there, they call Guillaume.

 Why This Job Is Different

 At Clifton Partners, you won't be a junior analyst formatting slides. Here you can earn a level of ownership almost no finance or business experience offers, alongside people operating at the top of their game. You'll be:

• Structuring Real Deals: Work on live $10M–$100M transactions for companies you've read about in TechCrunch.

• Accessing Exclusive Networks: Interface directly with secondary investors, family offices managing billions and founders building unicorns.

• Creating Market Intelligence: Your analysis will influence how institutional capital flows into private tech.

• Content Creation at the Core: Content is central to how we build our network and our edge. You'll contribute directly—from BILLIONS, Guillaume's show with unicorn founders, to the analysis and ideas we put in front of the market.

 What We're Looking For

• Education: Tier 1 business school (HEC, ESSEC, INSEAD, LSE, LBS, Bocconi, or equivalent).

• Languages: Fluent in English and in French.

• Experience: 6+ months in investment banking, boutique advisory or private equity.

• Bonus: Family office or VC experience, or involvement in entrepreneurial experience.

• Mindset: Entrepreneurial self-starter who thrives in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

• Technical: Strong financial modeling, and fluent with AI tools to work faster and sharper.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation skills and ability to distill complex information.

• Passion: Genuine interest in technology, startups, and content creation.

 The Deal

• Duration: 4–6 months with potential for full-time conversion.

• Location: Fully remote with occasional Paris, Monaco, London, Geneva and Dubai meetings (expenses covered).

• Compensation: Competitive monthly salary (€2,000).

• Access: Direct mentorship from the partners and the full team, not associates.

• Network: Introductions to our network of 500+ institutional investors.

• Start date: September / October.

 How to Apply

 We don't want your standard cover letter. Send us:

• Your CV—one page max.

• Your take—pick a private tech company and tell us why it's overvalued or undervalued (Loom format).

• Your edge—what unique insight or connection do you bring? (200 words).

• Optional: Something you've created—business, article, model, podcast or newsletter.

• References from previous experiences.

 Email gaspard@clifton.partners, simon@clifton.partners and d@clifton.partners with the subject line “Investment Analyst – [Your Name]”. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Start early.

 Hiring Process

• First screening based on profile.

• Case—48 hours maximum, five slides on a specific topic.

• Final stage—Q&A, final fit check and entrepreneurial mindset.

About Aegis Ventures 

 Aegis Ventures partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to launch and scale transformative companies in digital health and artificial intelligence. Our platform brings together market-shaping ideas, growth capital, and ambitious individuals to solve major societal problems. With a focus on innovations in healthcare, Aegis has launched four successful portfolio companies in partnership with Northwell Health and recently announced the Digital Consortium to co-develop, invest in, and launch new companies.

 About the Company 

 Aegis Ventures is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

 About the Job 

 As a  Venture Fellow at Aegis Ventures, you will have a unique opportunity to apply your clinical knowledge and business acumen in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are seeking a motivated graduate student with a strong background in consulting, finance, or business to join our team part-time.

 You will work closely with our leadership team to conduct due diligence on new investment opportunities, build new companies, and support the growth of our portfolio companies. Venture Fellows are expected to commit a minimum of two semesters, with a weekly time commitment of approximately 15 hours. This role can be remote within the U.S. or based in New York.

 What You'll Do 

• Evaluate new investment opportunities through due diligence.

• Help develop and launch new healthcare companies, from initial concept and business model development through company formation.

• Collaborate with Aegis portfolio companies on strategic priorities, including growth, partnerships, fundraising, and new market opportunities.

• Support a range of strategic initiatives across the Aegis platform, including thought leadership, industry events, and ecosystem engagement.

 What You'll Need 

• Currently enrolled in a graduate program.

• Previous experience in consulting, investment banking, or business.

• A desire to make a positive impact on patient outcomes.

• Ability to work independently with strong problem-solving and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and with AI.

 What We Offer 

• Experience evaluating early-stage investment opportunities.

• Exposure to many different business models within healthcare.

• A strong network of healthcare executives and entrepreneurs.

• Opportunities to participate in events and thought leadership initiatives.

• Hourly compensation.

 Hourly Rate 

• $50.00 per hour.

 Aegis Ventures is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer — we recruit, train, compensate and promote our team members based on qualifications. We encourage you to apply regardless of your race, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

About the Fellowship
 The Venture Capital Fellowship provides practical venture capital experience through deal sourcing, investment diligence, market analysis, and startup evaluation.
 Participants gain exposure to real deals while learning how venture capital firms identify, assess, and support high-growth startups. 1752vc invests up to $100,000 per company through a structured three-month investment program focused on AI, Enterprise Software, Fintech, Frontier Technology, Healthcare, and PropTech.
 Responsibilities
 Fellows will participate in:
 • Deal sourcing
• Startup research and market analysis
• Investment diligence and evaluation
• Founder outreach and relationship management
• Industry trend monitoring and competitive analysis
• VC education
 Ideal Candidates
 This fellowship is designed for:
 • Investment banking, consulting, finance, or strategy professionals
• Venture capital and private equity career aspirants
• MBA candidates and graduate students interested in investing
• Startup founders and operators seeking investing experience
• Emerging fund managers, angels, and family office professionals
 What You'll Learn
 • Venture capital investment processes
• Startup evaluation methodologies
• Deal sourcing and diligence frameworks
• Market sizing and competitive analysis
• Founder assessment and relationship management
• Portfolio support and venture operations
 Program Structure
 • 8 week structured fellowship
• Remote-first participation
• Flexible schedule for qualified professionals
• Exposure to active investment opportunities
• Collaboration investors and operators
 Location
 The fellowship operates virtually, with select optional in-person opportunities in Los Angeles.
 Compensation
 This is not a traditional salaried role. Compensation is available and tied to performance, with the potential for participants to share in the fund's upside.
 Equal Opportunity
 1752vc is committed to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion across all programs.
